item.title: New Council Bluffs mayor open to lifting 20-year pit bull ban
item.description: After 20 years, Council Bluffs might lift its pit bull ban. Mayor Shudak believes individual animals, not entire breeds, should be evaluated for safety risks. What's your take?

item.title: Gov. Pillen partners with Turning Point USA to bring 'Club America' chapters to all high schools
item.description: Nebraska Gov. Jim Pillen announced a partnership with Turning Point USA to establish 'Club America' chapters in every high school in the state, but did not take any questions.

item.title: Omaha develops 'Brain Gain' initiative as young professionals leave for other Midwest cities
item.description: Omaha launches new initiative to combat brain drain as young professionals leave for job opportunities in other Midwest cities like Kansas City, Denver, and Des Moines.
